title: pvLinearCellExtrusion
body:
## pvLinearCellExtrusion

Extrudes every polygon of a polygonal surface independently into a 3-D cell (triangles to wedges, quads to hexahedra, other polygons to polyhedra) by a length equal to a cell scalar times ScaleFactor, along the cell normal or a user vector; the output is an unstructured grid. Use it for 3-D bar maps, e.g. building heights on a footprint map or values drawn as columns on a surface. Use pvLinearExtrusion to sweep the whole surface by one vector.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Only polygons are extruded; vertices, lines and triangle strips are discarded.
- The length array must be a single-component cell array.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `LinearCellExtrusion`. Identity: `filters/LinearCellExtrusionFilter`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Linear Cell Extrusion filter. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). The input needs at least one cell-centred array with 1 component. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `MergeDuplicatePoints` | Remove duplicate points. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ScaleFactor` | Scale factor applied to the extrusion length. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `SelectInputScalars` | The array used to set the extrusion length. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `UseUserVector` | Use a custom extrusion direction. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `UserVector` | Set the custom extrusion direction. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
